messages:
jordan_ae: Heads-up — AcmeEdge RFI follow-up. They flagged tenant isolation for embeddings and want a clear breakdown of model fallback cost tradeoffs. Need a short RFI response + capability matrix by EOD. Attaching the draft in Drive. Who can own the tech answers? cc @maria_se @sarah_security

maria_se: I can own the technical answers. Quick clarifying Qs: they want per-tenant network+data isolation for embeddings, and an automatic fallback from on-prem quantized models to hosted high-accuracy variants. Do we treat that as a Private-only ask or can Dedicated satisfy the isolation requirements?

owen_infra: Dedicated gives isolation at instance-pool and tenant-level config, but not full customer-managed VPC peering. If they require customer-managed networking and HSM keys under their account, that's Private. Capacity back-of-envelope: ~2 p100-eq GPUs for 1k req/min at 512 tokens with 95th pct latency target ~250ms (with batching). Autoscale + burst handles spikes.

sarah_security: Security summary for RFI: we support KMS integrations (AWS/GCP/Azure) and customer-managed HSM for Private deployments. We provide SOC2 Type II and audit logs; FedRAMP is not available for hosted today. We'll include a control mapping table and the filled security questionnaire.

lee_prod: For fallback/rollout guidance: recommend primary = local quantized model (cost-optimized), fallback = hosted higher-accuracy variant. Enforce canary rollout + circuit-breaker: if p50 > 400ms or error rate > 2% for 5 minutes, switch to fallback and alert. Add token-based throttles to prevent cascade.

mike_sales_ops: POC commercial options: 60-day eval with a one-time Dedicated trial (2 weeks) free of infra charges; hosted tokens billed at 50% off for the eval period. Customer pays cloud egress and any on-prem install services. NDA required before we ship Private artifacts. I'll prepare a pricing sheet + line items for support hours.

maria_se: I'll draft the capability matrix. Proposed columns: feature, supported? (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), recommended config, constraints. Quick snippet for the RFI to preview:

```
Feature | Hosted | Dedicated | Private | Notes
Tenant isolation (network + keys) | Partial | Yes (instance-level) | Yes (VPC + BYO-HSM) | Private required for customer-managed peering
Embeddings isolation (per-tenant) | Logical isolation | Logical + pool isolation | Physical network isolation | Depends on regulatory needs
Model fallback (accuracy vs cost) | Hosted fallback available | Swap to hosted variant | Swap to hosted variant | Fallback policy + canary required
```

jordan_ae: Perfect. @sarah_security can you drop the filled questionnaire and the control mapping XLSX here? @mike_sales_ops add the pricing PDF. I'll consolidate and send the RFI response + attachments to AcmeEdge by EOD. :thumbsup:

sarah_security: Uploaded: https://drive.company.com/acme/security_answers_acme.xlsx — short summary in the sheet. Keys: KMS=yes; HSM=yes for Private; SOC2=yes; FedRAMP=no. I'll add narrative on control mappings later today.

mike_sales_ops: Uploaded: https://drive.company.com/acme/acme_poc_pricing_v1.pdf — includes eval pricing, Dedicated trial line, monitoring add-on, and recommended SRE support hours. Putting a note for Legal to review NDA.

jordan_ae: Thanks everyone — I'll stitch into the RFI doc and ping the customer. If anything else comes up I’ll post updates here.
